parameters.query:
INSERT INTO msp_cache.cache_eset_devices
  (uuid, hostname, mac, bios_serial, disk_serial, hardware_uuid,
   eset_email, account_id, display_name, last_seen, status, threats,
   products, os, os_version, cpu, disk_gb)
SELECT
  x.uuid, x.hostname, x.mac, x.bios_serial, x.disk_serial, x.hardware_uuid,
  x.eset_email, x.account_id, x.display_name,
  CASE WHEN x.last_seen IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE x.last_seen::timestamptz END,
  x.status, x.threats, x.products, x.os, x.os_version, x.cpu, x.disk_gb
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(
  uuid text, hostname text, mac text, bios_serial text, disk_serial text,
  hardware_uuid text, eset_email text, account_id bigint, display_name text,
  last_seen text, status text, threats integer, products text[],
  os text, os_version text, cpu text, disk_gb integer
)
ON CONFLICT (uuid) DO UPDATE SET
  hostname = EXCLUDED.hostname, mac = EXCLUDED.mac,
  bios_serial = EXCLUDED.bios_serial, disk_serial = EXCLUDED.disk_serial,
  hardware_uuid = EXCLUDED.hardware_uuid, eset_email = EXCLUDED.eset_email,
  account_id = EXCLUDED.account_id, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name,
  last_seen = EXCLUDED.last_seen, status = EXCLUDED.status,
  threats = EXCLUDED.threats, products = EXCLUDED.products,
  os = EXCLUDED.os, os_version = EXCLUDED.os_version,
  cpu = EXCLUDED.cpu, disk_gb = EXCLUDED.disk_gb,
  synced_at = NOW()
RETURNING uuid;

parameters.jsCode: const n = $("Expand devices").all().length; return [{json:{system:"eset_devices", rows_written:n, floor:1}}];
